comparisonFindings.result: The clean prompt shows the character at a window. Adding classroom + fantasy forest + white background removes the character and produces a hybrid empty environment.
The clean prompt gives a balanced boy-and-girl pair. Adding solo creates a giant foreground female face and a tiny male figure.
With the same seed and tags, early full body shows shoes; late full body is outside the 77-token context and the figure is cropped above the knees.
The compact action prompt is weak at low settings; combining three actions duplicates the subject and none of the requested actions is rendered reliably.
